entries.title: Job 14:1
segments: ¶As for man, the son of woman, his days are short and full of trouble.

entries.title: Job 14:2
segments: He comes out like a flower, and is cut down: he goes in flight like a shade, and is never seen again.

entries.title: Job 14:3
segments: Is it on such a one as this that your eyes are fixed, with the purpose of judging him?

entries.title: Job 14:4
segments: If only a clean thing might come out of an unclean! But it is not possible.

entries.title: Job 14:5
segments: If his days are ordered, and you have knowledge of the number of his months, having given him a fixed limit past which he may not go;

entries.title: Job 14:6
segments: Let your eyes be turned away from him, and take your hand from him, so that he may have pleasure at the end of his day, like a servant working for payment.

entries.title: Job 14:7
segments: ¶For there is hope of a tree; if it is cut down, it will come to life again, and its branches will not come to an end.

entries.title: Job 14:8
segments: Though its root may be old in the earth, and its cut-off end may be dead in the dust;

entries.title: Job 14:9
segments: Still, at the smell of water, it will make buds, and put out branches like a young plant.

entries.title: Job 14:10
segments: But man comes to his death and is gone: he gives up his spirit, and where is he?

entries.title: Job 14:11
segments: The waters go from a pool, and a river becomes waste and dry;

entries.title: Job 14:12
segments: So man goes down to his last resting-place and comes not again: till the heavens come to an end, they will not be awake or come out of their sleep.

entries.title: Job 14:13
segments: If only you would keep me safe in the underworld, putting me in a secret place till your wrath is past, giving me a fixed time when I might come to your memory again!

entries.title: Job 14:14
segments: If death takes a man, will he come to life again? All the days of my trouble I would be waiting, till the time came for me to be free.

entries.title: Job 14:15
segments: At the sound of your voice I would give an answer, and you would have a desire for the work of your hands.

entries.title: Job 14:16
segments: ¶For now my steps are numbered by you, and my sin is not overlooked.

entries.title: Job 14:17
segments: My wrongdoing is corded up in a bag, and my sin is shut up safe.

entries.title: Job 14:18
segments: But truly a mountain falling comes to dust, and a rock is moved from its place;

entries.title: Job 14:19
segments: The stones are crushed small by the force of the waters; the dust of the earth is washed away by their overflowing: and so you put an end to the hope of man.

entries.title: Job 14:20
segments: You overcome him for ever, and he is gone; his face is changed in death, and you send him away.

entries.title: Job 14:21
segments: His sons come to honour, and he has no knowledge of it; they are made low, but he is not conscious of it.

entries.title: Job 14:22
segments: Only his flesh still has pain, and his soul is sad.
